about: Python/TypeScript parity fixture. web/lib/simulate.ts must reproduce every mu and every field of expected, reading the same contract/posterior.fixture.json.
z_note: A new-city case carries `z`: the standard-normal draws it used. They are draws.z_new rotated left by (scenario.seed mod n_draws). Do NOT generate them with a local PRNG — numpy and a browser PRNG cannot agree, and the browser would then disagree with the reference on every new-city scenario.
check_weeks_note: mu is recorded only at mu.weeks (promo window, the dip week, and a late week). expected.weekly covers all horizon weeks.

cases.name: promo-students-boston
cases.about: 20% off for students in Boston for 4 weeks. Exercises b_promo, the price term, the b_dip week, and the rule that unselected cells stay at baseline and cancel out of the incremental.

cases.name: price-plus-8pct-all
cases.about: A permanent +8% price change everywhere. Exercises the elasticity term on every cell and a scenario with no promo weeks.

cases.name: new-city-miami
cases.about: Launch in Miami, which is out of the training trait range. Exercises a_new = g0 + traits_z.g + tau_city*z with the seeded z draw, the zero baseline, the candidate's segment mix, and the extrapolation flag.

warnings: Miami is outside the training range on median_income_k, share_age_18_34. The forecast extrapolates; treat the interval as a lower bound on the real uncertainty.
